labels.text: Sections 4375(a) and 4376(a): the fee per covered life. Fiscal year 2013: $1; fiscal year 2014: $2. From fiscal year 2015 the amount is increased by the percentage increase in projected national health expenditures published by the Secretary (subsections (d)); those publications are not pinned, so fiscal years 2015-2029 are gaps inside the coverage (MISSING_PARAMETER_VALUE). Read with legal_time on the last day of the policy or plan year.
section 4375(a), 4376(a): $1 for policy or plan years ending during fiscal year 2013
section 4375(a), 4376(a): $2 (the statutory base) for policy or plan years ending during fiscal year 2014, before the adjustment of subsection (d) starts
